create_HitlDriver: create a HitlDriver instance with config, gui input, debug line drawer, text drawer, and app state lambda
call_sim_update: call sim_update on HitlDriver to advance the simulation by a delta time and return post update dict
call_end_episode: call _end_episode on HitlDriver to save recorded data and optionally reset the environment for the next episode
call_reset_environment: call _reset_environment on HitlDriver to reset the gym habitat environment and reinitialize controllers and recorders
use_requires_habitat_sim_with_bullet: use the requires_habitat_sim_with_bullet decorator to enforce that habitat-sim was built with bullet physics support
